easyPrerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Lagrella until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
